steps.instruction: Beat 4 eggs, 1/2 cup of sugar and 1 pinch of salt until frothy.
Mix 3/4 cup of flour, 1 teaspoon baking powder and the zest of 1 lemon.
Fold the flour mixture into the egg mixture.
Fold in 5 tablespoons of melted butter.
Divide the dough into greased madeleine molds.
steps.spoken: Divide the dough into greased madeleine molds. The dough will rise in the oven to fill the molds.

steps.instruction: Bake for 12 minutes, until the cakes are springy but not browned.
steps.spoken: Bake for 12 to fifteen minutes, until the cakes are springy but not browned.
